atoms.title: Endpoint detection and response (EDR)
atoms.objective: Describe how an EDR platform collects telemetry from a device, explain how it classifies process and file activity as suspicious or clean, and identify the core actions an EDR takes when it detects a threat.

atoms.title: Log analysis
atoms.objective: Explain what a security log records and why it matters, identify the common log sources security analysts review, and detect a brute-force login pattern by correlating multiple log entries over time.

atoms.title: Identifying compromised devices (indicators of compromise)
atoms.objective: Define an indicator of compromise (IOC), classify common IOC categories, and combine multiple IOCs on a single device into an overall compromise verdict using weighted scoring.
